core: Type I congenital disorders of glycosylation
qualifier: defective dolichol-oligosaccharide glycosyltransferases (ALG, DPAGT1)
name: Type I CDG from defective dolichol-oligosaccharide glycosyltransferases
rationale: All members are CDG-I caused by defects in ALG/DPAGT1 glycosyltransferases that build the lipid-linked oligosaccharide, unlike confusables centred on mannose donor synthesis (PMM2, MPI, DPM, DOLK) or other steps (RFT1, MPDU1, type II).

qualifier: hypusine and diphthamide modification of elongation factors
name: Polyamine metabolism and hypusine/diphthamide elongation-factor modification
rationale: Members cover polyamine synthesis, interconversion, oxidation and transport plus the hypusine (eIF5A) and diphthamide (EEF2) modifications and related protein hydroxylation, which distinguish it from confusables about tRNA aminoacylation, protein methylation or selenocysteine/readthrough.

qualifier: nuclear and mitochondrial
name: Nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA maturation, modification and aminoacylation
rationale: Members are dominated by tRNA processing, base modification and charging in cytosol and mitochondria, whereas confusables concern rRNA modification, mitoribosome assembly or mitochondrial translation and transcription.

qualifier: mesenchymal proliferation, survival and progenitor maintenance
name: Kidney development control via mesenchymal proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate kidney growth through cell proliferation, apoptosis and nephron progenitor maintenance, unlike confusables about nephron/duct morphogenesis and mesenchymal-to-epithelial differentiation.

qualifier: nutrient and energy sensing via AKT-TSC and LKB1-AMPK
name: Nutrient- and energy-sensing mTORC1 control via AKT, TSC, AMPK
rationale: Members describe amino acid, glucose and energy inputs to mTORC1/TORC2 via AKT-TSC and LKB1-AMPK, whereas confusables centre on PTEN regulation and ERBB2/3 or phosphoinositide signalling.

qualifier: pexophagy, aggrephagy, microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy
name: Selective autophagy: pexophagy, aggrephagy, micro- and chaperone-mediated
rationale: Members are cargo-specific autophagy routes and autophagosome cargo targeting, distinct from confusables on PINK1-PRKN mitochondrial quality control, aggresome/ERAD protein quality control or negative regulation of autophagosomes.

core: Urea cycle citrulline and arginine synthesis
qualifier: ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency
name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis and OTC deficiency
rationale: Members share urea cycle citrulline/arginine biosynthesis with OTC variant disorders, whereas confusables cover other enzyme deficiencies (CPS1, ASS1, ASL, ARG1, NAGS) or ornithine/arginine transport and catabolism.

qualifier: IL-12, IL-23 and IL-10
name: Interleukin-12, interleukin-23 and interleukin-10 signalling
rationale: All members are IL-12, IL-23 or IL-10 signalling pathways, distinguishing the theme from confusables on IL-15/21, IL-17/Th17, IL-33/36/38 or IL-27/35/37.

core: Cytoskeletal remodelling of dendrites and synapses
qualifier: dendrite arborization, filopodia and postsynaptic structure
name: Cytoskeletal control of dendrite arborization and postsynaptic structure
rationale: Members regulate actin/microtubule organisation underlying dendrite branching, filopodia and postsynaptic density structure (incl. EPHB and RHO GTPase signalling), whereas confusables emphasise NMDAR-RAC1, BDNF-NTRK2, reelin signalling and synaptic plasticity.

qualifier: hyaluronan degradation
name: Scavenger receptor uptake and hyaluronan degradation
rationale: Members are class A, B, F and H scavenger receptor pathways together with hyaluronan catabolism, distinguishing them from confusables on oxidised LDL/foam cells or apoptotic cell clearance.

qualifier: execution of pyroptotic cell death
name: Pyroptotic cell death execution and its defects
rationale: All three members describe pyroptotic cell death itself, while confusables concern upstream inflammasome assembly, caspase-4/5 activity and IL-1 processing.

qualifier: stimulated CD4 T cells
name: Mitotic proliferation of stimulated CD4 T cells
rationale: All members are cell-division modules from stimulated CD4 T cells, unlike the generic G2/M, E2F and DNA replication confusables.

qualifier: male germline and sperm chromatin remodelling
name: Male germline development and sperm chromatin remodelling
rationale: Members span germ cell specification, germline stem cells, spermatogonial division, piRNA control of retroelements and protamine/sperm DNA packaging, whereas confusables emphasise heterochromatin silencing, oocyte/maternal-to-zygotic transition and imprinting.

qualifier: reward and behavioural responses to addictive drugs
name: Dopaminergic signalling and reward responses to addictive drugs
rationale: Members combine dopamine receptor signalling with behavioural and cellular responses to cocaine, nicotine, ethanol, amphetamine and opioids, unlike confusables on catecholamine transport, neuropeptides or social behaviours.

qualifier: assembly, intraciliary trafficking and motility including sperm flagella
name: Cilium and flagellum assembly, trafficking and motility
rationale: Members cover ciliogenesis, intraflagellar and ciliary cargo transport, axoneme and dynein arm assembly, and motile cilia/sperm flagellum functions, unlike confusables on photoreceptor development, mitotic centrosomes or tubulin modification.

qualifier: keratinocyte migration in wound re-epithelialization
name: Epithelial and keratinocyte migration control in wound healing
rationale: Members regulate epithelial/keratinocyte migration, epidermal spreading, focal adhesion and ECM disassembly, distinct from confusables on keratinocyte proliferation/IL-20 or inhibition of cell adhesion and spreading.

qualifier: Gi/Gz inhibitory signalling via alpha-2 adrenergic receptors
name: Gi/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition by alpha-2 adrenergic receptors
rationale: Members centre on cyclic-nucleotide GPCR signalling inhibiting adenylate cyclase via G alpha i/z and alpha-2 adrenoceptors, unlike confusables on adrenergic control of insulin/catecholamine secretion, muscarinic or adenosine receptors.

qualifier: gastric acid secretion, gut smooth muscle motility and stomach development
name: Gastrointestinal motility, gastric acid secretion and stomach development
rationale: All members concern stomach and gut function or development, whereas confusables cover enteric nervous system development, smooth muscle in other organs, or serotonin receptors.

qualifier: centromeric cohesion and its resolution at separation
name: Centromeric sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
rationale: Members describe maintenance and resolution of sister chromatid cohesion leading to separation, distinct from confusables on APC/C regulation and the spindle assembly checkpoint.

qualifier: with ER tubular network organization
name: Phospholipid flipping, intermembrane transfer and ER tubular network
rationale: Members cover aminophospholipid flipping and scrambling, intermembrane lipid transfer and ER tubule formation/fusion, unlike confusables on phosphoinositide synthesis, Golgi vesicle traffic, mitochondria-ER tethering or glycolipid transport.

qualifier: base excision repair gap filling and error-prone translesion synthesis
name: BER gap-filling and error-prone translesion DNA synthesis
rationale: Members are polymerase-driven steps of long-patch/single-nucleotide base excision repair and POLK/POLI/REV1 translesion synthesis, unlike confusables on glycosylase recognition, mismatch repair, NER/POLH or replication.

qualifier: myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion in regeneration
name: Myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion in muscle regeneration
rationale: Members regulate myoblast commitment, proliferation, migration, differentiation and fusion including satellite cell activation, unlike confusables on muscle atrophy, satellite cell maintenance or fiber differentiation.

qualifier: tetrahydrobiopterin, molybdenum cofactor and vitamin B6
name: Cofactor biosynthesis: tetrahydrobiopterin, molybdenum cofactor and vitamin B6
rationale: Members are prosthetic group/cofactor pathways (BH4, Moco, PLP) and processes depending on them (phenylalanine hydroxylation, sulfide oxidation), distinguishing them from confusables on tyrosine catabolism or sulfur amino acid and serine metabolism.

qualifier: PLC and beta-arrestin routes and synaptic modulation
name: Dopaminergic synaptic modulation via PLC and beta-arrestin signalling
rationale: Members are non-cAMP dopamine receptor signalling (PLC-activating, beta-arrestin) with dopamine release and synaptic modulation, unlike confusables centred on adenylate cyclase-coupled dopamine receptors or drug responses.

core: Membrane potential and Na+/K+ gradient maintenance
qualifier: P-type ATPases and calcium-activated/TRESK K+ channels
name: Na+/K+ gradient and resting membrane potential maintenance
rationale: Members maintain transmembrane Na+/K+ gradients and resting/action potentials via P-type ATPases (glycoside-sensitive) and Ca2+-activated and TRESK K+ channels, unlike confusables on other K2P/KATP channels or renal sodium transport.
